deviations.what: the sap.m.plugins.UploadSetwithTable control (since UI5 1.124) is newer than 1.71 and is the whole point of this sample - three instances, each kept 1:1 in its table's dependents as plugins:UploadSetwithTable (the original's dotted plugins.UploadSetwithTable under the sap.m default namespace) with its rowConfiguration aggregation and its customData (the core:CustomData itemsPath the controller reads); the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.124. Every member they carry (uploadUrl, multiple, cloudFilePickerEnabled, the actions association, beforeUploadStarts) is as new as the plugin.

the plugin's companion controls are kept 1:1 and are post-1.71 too: sap.m.upload.ActionsPlaceholder (@since 1.120, with placeholderFor - the toolbar slot the plugin renders its upload button into) and sap.m.upload.UploadItemConfiguration (@since 1.124; fileNamePath, mediaTypePath, urlPath, previewablePath and fileSizePath @1.124, isTrustedSourcePath @1.125), written upload:UploadItemConfiguration for the original's dotted upload.UploadItemConfiguration.
sap.m.Column importance (@since 1.76) on the File Name and action columns, and sap.m.Table autoPopinMode (@since 1.76) and hiddenInPopin (@since 1.77), are kept 1:1 from the original table.

The named JSONModel documents (manifest dataSource model/documents.json) is folded into the default model: every {documents>x} binding is the row field {X}, and the three arrays items, items-instance2 and items-instance3 are the bound T_ITEMS, T_ITEMSINSTANCE2 and T_ITEMSINSTANCE3 (an ABAP name cannot carry the hyphen), still as the original's {path, templateShareable: false} binding info. All nine rows (three per array) are inlined; the url and imageUrl fields are host-absolutized to https://sdk.openui5.org/test-resources/... because an abap2UI5 app has no demo-kit root to resolve the relative test-resources paths against. The UploadItemConfiguration paths name the upper-case ABAP fields (FILENAME, MEDIATYPE, URL, PREVIEWABLE, FILESIZE, TRUSTEDSOURCE) instead of fileName/mediaType/... - the same model columns. IMAGEURL and UPLOADSTATE are bound with omit_initial_paths, so a row the mock gives no imageUrl/uploadState still reads undefined and the original's own Image/Icon visible expressions and highlight expression decide exactly as in the sample.

The controller formatters getIconSrc (UploadSetwithTable.getIconForFileType - IconPool's media-type table, the file-extension fallback with sap-icon://card for images) and getFileSizeWithUnits (KB/MB/GB with two decimals) run in ABAP (icon_for, size_with_units) and the row carries the finished values in two port fields, ICON and FILESIZE_UNITS, which core:Icon.src and the File Size Text bind - the thin-frontend rule; the {parts: [...], formatter: ...} bindings are gone with them.

Upload: the sample starts a sinon fake XHR server (model/mockserver.js) in beforeUploadStarts, which answers the POST to /uploadFiles with 201 and unshifts the new document. There is no such endpoint behind an abap2UI5 app, so the port plays the mock server's part in the backend: beforeUploadStarts is a backend wire with check_prevent_default (the plugin's own veto - no XHR is sent) that transports the item's file name, media type and size plus the plugin's own customData itemsPath ($event.oSource.data('itemsPath') - what onBeforeUploadStarts hands the mock server as instancePath), and the backend unshifts into that array the row the mock server would have created (uploadState Complete, revision 00, In work, Jane Burns, Invoice, trustedSource) and shows the 'Document Added' toast at once rather than after the sample's one-second setTimeout. Lost with it: the uploaded file's blob: object URL (an uploaded row has an empty url, so it cannot be previewed or downloaded) and the random uid id (a running number); uploadCompleted and onActivated are not wired (no upload completes, and each plugin is addressed by an added id - uploadSetPlugin, uploadSetPlugin-instance2, uploadSetPlugin-instance3 - instead of the instances onActivated handed the controller); URLListValidator.add('blob') is dropped. Several files picked at once fire beforeUploadStarts back to back and abap2UI5 runs one round-trip at a time: check_queue_last keeps the last one, so only the first and the last of them are added.

onDownloadFiles calls download( context, true ) for EVERY selected row of the table; a UI5 event expression has no loop, so each Download button calls download for the first selected row of its own table only, through a view-wired control_by_id on that table's plugin with $controller.getView().byId(<table id>).getSelectedContexts()[0]. (The original always ends up in its first plugin instance - it looks for 'instance2' in the id of the table's PARENT, the VBox - which downloads the same files, since download only reads the context it is given.)

Unverified in a running system: (a) the plugin calls by id (uploadSetPlugin, uploadSetPlugin-instance2, uploadSetPlugin-instance3 - ids the original does not carry) through the unlisted-method path of control_by_id - openFilePreview with the Link's $event.oSource.getBindingContext() and download with $controller.getView().byId(<table id>).getSelectedContexts()[0] - each handing the live Context object through castArgAuto untouched; (b) the vetoed beforeUploadStarts with ${$parameters>/item}.getFileObject().size and $event.oSource.data('itemsPath').

The controller's quirks are kept 1:1 where they decide what happens to the data: every SearchField's onSearch filters the FIRST table (byId('table-uploadSet')) - the three liveChange wires are the same view-wired binding_call filter on that table; removeItem splices the clicked row's index out of /items and clears the first table's selection whichever table the row belongs to (the MessageBox still names the clicked document) - the port deletes from T_ITEMS by the index in the row's binding path. Where the quirk only picks an equivalent instance the port is direct: openPreview reads 'instance2' from the template Link's generated id, so the original always previews through the first plugin; each port Link calls its own table's plugin. onSelectionChange enables each table's Download button from its own selection (the wire carries the table id and getSelectedContexts().length); after a removal the first table's Download button is disabled with its cleared selection (removeSelections fires no selectionChange, so the original left it enabled).

removeItem's MessageBox.warning keeps its text, actions Remove/CANCEL, emphasizedAction, styleClass and initialFocus; its explicit icon option is the warning box's own icon anyway. The mock server's 'Document Added' toast follows at once instead of after the controller's one-second setTimeout (see the upload deviation).

The sample ships view/fragment/AddViaUrl.fragment.xml (a Dialog addViaUrlDialog holding a form:SimpleForm addViaUrlSimpleform with two Label controls urlInputLabel and nameInputLabel - both required - two Input controls urlInput and nameInput, and the Button controls addDocumentBtn and Cancel), but nothing in this variant loads it: its view has no Add menu and its controller no openAddOrEditDialog / handleAddViaUrl. The port does not build the dead fragment, so structural_diff, which unions every archived fragment with the view, counts its controls as missing.
